title: Review of c45's Marangoni turnover tuning: Weak. On fresh seed 84 the best setting (p 0.10 with matter put back) keeps 17-20 bodies with 5-6 persistent splits per 20 frames and reaches generation 5, and divisions continue after frame 120 in both settings; no dividing rod swims 3 lengths, as claimed
summary: Re-ran the finding's world (c34's Marangoni rods with trait-blind whole-body dilution every 10 frames) on seed 84 for 150 frames at p_dil 0.10 with REDIST and at p_dil 0.20, with c00's extract.py and c45's turnover_stats.py unchanged. p 0.10 REDIST: 22 persistent splits, generation 5; splits per 20-frame window 0/2/6/1/6/5/2/0 with 17-20 bodies at the dilutions of frames 80-120 and 2 splits in frames 120-140 (pack lineage.png: generation 4-5 daughters born at t~600-700). p 0.20: 14 persistent splits, generation 3, 9-13 bodies, 2 splits in frames 120-140. Dividing tracks with D >= 3 rod lengths: 0 of 14 and 0 of 9.

observations.D: p0.10_redist/stats.txt (seed 84): 6 and 5 persistent splits in frames 80-100 and 100-120 with 17-20 bodies, 2 in frames 120-140, generation 5 (lineage.png); p0.20/stats.txt: 4 and 2 splits in frames 100-140 with 9-13 bodies

seeds_run.result: partly contradicts: the REDIST p 0.10 setting meets the 12-20 bodies / >= 5 splits per 20 frames target in two windows and both settings divide after frame 120; D >= 3 count (0) replicates

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed, two of the eight settings, 150 frames: the finding's 'births stop after frame 120 in all 8 settings' holds on seed 80 but not on seed 84 for these two settings, so the negative is seed-dependent rather than general; the best setting is a better start for Q:marangoni-turnover-persistence than the finding suggests. That the swimming minority does not appear (0 of 23 dividing tracks reach 3 rod lengths) agrees with the finding. I did not check the T=2000 follow-up.
